summary: Isolate USDB rule catalogs on a shared Bitcoin source
details: Explicit rule scopes and pinned external catalogs bind registry and active-version identities across Rust indexing, RPC state commitments, and Go verification while retaining legacy hashes.
Pass and energy databases enforce the selected source, scope, origin, and registry revision; scoped checkpoints carry a signed catalog and reject incompatible restore targets.
Deployment renderers preserve frozen rule selectors, and audit manifest v4 groups independent catalogs by source and scope. Existing testnet-v0 artifacts and activation rules are unchanged.
operator_actions: Keep the existing legacy configuration for v0. A future scoped deployment requires a reviewed catalog, an exact registry pin, matching Go artifacts, and a separate dataset; current-registry changes do not support in-place data migration.
